source_text: Quoniam lex spiritalis est, petamus Dominum ut umbras in veritatem aperiat. Pascha nostrum Christus.
pass_a_gloss: Since law spiritual is, let-us-ask Lord that shadows into truth he-may-open. Passover our Christ.
pass_b_english: Since the [[law is spiritual >> Bible:Romans 7:14]], ask the Lord to open shadows into truth. [[Christ our Passover >> Bible:1 Corinthians 5:7]].
